scope: Correct independently confirmed midnight-transition gap using new immutable calendar-v3 profile; preserve v1/v2, prepare inert both-chart boundaries with one captured reference. Public browser metadata addendum only, no infrastructure spending.
riskAnalysis: STRICT task authority, source integrity, restricted filesystem, cancellation and release identity; no new paid or publication authority.

threatModel.assets: Curated repository source, task and review bindings, worker filesystem, immutable evidence and budget.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner dashboard to existing journal; authority to bounded trusted child; proposed text is untrusted inert data, never code execution.
threatModel.abuseCases: Stale or substituted source/proposal/runtime, reordered or overlapping edits, forged acceptance, late cancellation, secret-bearing build context and unbounded browser charges.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact hashes and full context binding, cloned inputs, unique ordered bounded edits, empty child environment, Node filesystem permission, pre/post fenced authority, final CAS and destruction. Browser recipe inactive.

rollback: Revert Preview preparation modules and UI preset only; preserve legacy v1/v2 records, existing receipts and original source. Revoke active non-billable task before rollback; Production unchanged.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown keys, paths, oversized/overlapping/reversed edits and altered manifests fail fixed validators.
negativePaths.concurrency: Process-owned temporary namespaces prevent false cleanup claims from concurrent tests; existing final CAS remains.
negativePaths.cancellation: Actual child cancellation/timeout waits for cleanup before rejection; no receipt after authority loss.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Child exit/start failures deny artifact; parent-crash orphan and OS resource isolation remain limitations, no untrusted execution enabled.
negativePaths.api-outage: No new provider call in preparation; existing public CI outage produces unavailable evidence, no retries.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Trusted before/after callback must return exact true; existing owner/workspace/task authority and stale claim checks remain.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Paid execution and browser spending disabled; no allowance use, approval or provider dispatch added.
negativePaths.partial-execution: No partial artifact is accepted; source identity and cleanup verified before returned result.

defects.rootCause: The v2 proposal copied a normalized01:00 midnight-transition start, carrying that hour to the next boundary; existing start loop also carried01:00 into historical days.
defects.detectionGap: Initial US/LordHowe day-length cases did not challenge zones changing offset at local midnight or a render spanning midnight.
defects.regression: Santiago2026Sep6, SaoPaulo2018Nov4, captured-reference rollover, Apia skipped civil date, both actual Ops profile paths and source-bound inert patches; old artifact retained.
defects.historicalPrevention: Version v3 independently derives start/end from one captured calendar reference. Do not mutate published v2 receipt semantics; retain skipped-day UI uncertainty.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extend existing journal, role contracts and restricted text child; no new controller or authorization ledger.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Existing pinned Node, Playwright1.55.0 recipe, curated source lock, exact runtime/release/deployment and Redis CAS; no new package installation.
proactiveReview.threats: Proposal injection, stale authority, substituted evidence, forged review, accidental runtime execution or implicit infrastructure spending.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing exact source/runtime denies preparation. Unconfirmed browser digest/quote blocks build; no paid fallback or retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Altered proposal/binding/patch, authority denial, ignored preauth, child timeout/cancellation and malicious inert throw text remain covered.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA confirmed midnight defect, verified v3 actual patch applicability and parser-only validity; Auditor approved actual source and unchanged legacy profile behavior.55 composed tests pass.
proactiveReview.recovery: Await child cleanup on failure, preserve old evidence; no authority restoration. Parent-hardkill orphan remains explicit future isolation limitation.
proactiveReview.readiness: New source requires frozen STRICT then remoteCI/Redis/CodeQL and exact hosted v3 assignment/Browser. Prior e158 full results preserved, initial pin failure retained. No paid activation.
